EDIT EART
BARC 0 2 4 2 6 2 14
V=0
D=6000
G=32
FUEL=2000
CLOC=0
WHIL D GT 0
DO B=KEYB
T=KEYB
IF B GT 0
THEN BT=FUEL{DIV}B MIN T
ELSE BT=T
ENDI
D=D-(V{MUL}T+T*2{MUL}G{DIV}2-BT*2{MUL}B{DIV}2)
V=V+G{MUL}T-B{MUL}BT
FUEL=FUEL-BT{MUL}B
CLOC=CLOC+T
BARH (D,0,V,0,FUEL,0,CLOC{MUL}100){DIV}6000{MUL}64
D,V,FUEL,CLOC
ENDW
IF V LT 15
THEN "SUCCESS"
ELSE "CRASH"
ENDI
V,CLOC,2000-FUEL
ENDP
ENDE
